messages:
Sam: Quick follow-up from the BR-2026 postmortem. We need concrete owners + deadlines for the rollout safety items (auto-rollback policy, feature-flag containment templates, telemetry gating + runbook hooks). Please ack or volunteer.
Maya: I'll own auto-rollback policy and runtime wiring. Plan: runtime config + unit/integration tests + doc. ETA: 2026-03-28. Assigning ACTION-342.
Connor: I'll take containment/flag templates and default caps for hot paths. Will draft DSL and examples for services. ETA: 2026-04-04. ACTION-343.
Priya: I'll do rollout telemetry and runbook integration (dashboards, regression smoke tests, alert playbooks). Proposing min_sample = 100 for gating. ETA: 2026-04-06. ACTION-344.
Alex: Ops will add quarantine timer and an Ops dashboard for guarded rollouts. Proposed quarantine: 3m then auto-pause; also add manual override. ETA: 2026-03-30. ACTION-345.
ops-bot: Created INF-789: rollout-drift-alerts, linked BR-2026.
Maya: Draft runtime policy snippet for review:
```json
{
  "autoRollback": true,
  "threshold_pct_errors": 5,
  "window_secs": 120,
  "min_sample": 100,
  "fallback_model": "redwood-safe-v1"
}
```
Connor: For containment templates I'm thinking small DSL examples: `scope: {percent_users: 10, regions: ["us-west-2"]}`, `max_concurrent: 1000` for hot paths. Will include per-service default caps and a safety multiplier.
Priya: Telemetry gating rules proposal:
- error_rate > 3% (window)
- p50 latency increase > 20%
Require min_sample before any auto-rollback triggers.
Sam: Let's make sure PRs reference the postmortem tracker: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortem/BR-2026?action-tracker and include test plans. Can people confirm PR dates?
Connor: Ack. I'll pair with Maya on integration tests Thursday afternoon.
Maya: Opening runtime PR today and adding @Priya and @Sam as reviewers.
Alex: I'll schedule a 15m ops sync on Friday to validate dashboard signals and quarantine behavior — invite sent.
Sam: Thanks all. I'll own closure verification and update the recurring-incident checklist. Follow-up check-in in two weeks (2026-04-07). :thumbsup:
